title: AC1: verify the required behavior
preconditions: Required feature state and valid test data are available.
steps: Execute the exact condition described in AC1: Given a registered, active user, when they enter their correct email and password and click Log In, then they are redirected to the dashboard.
expected_result: The system satisfies AC1 exactly, including the stated outcome and message/state.

title: Reject a prohibited or invalid condition
preconditions: Feature is available.
steps: Exercise AC1 with an invalid, missing, unauthorized, expired, or prohibited condition relevant to the criterion.
expected_result: The system rejects the invalid condition and preserves the required state/error behavior.

title: AC2: verify the required behavior
preconditions: Required feature state and valid test data are available.
steps: Execute the exact condition described in AC2: Given a registered user, when they enter a correct email but wrong password, then an error "Invalid email or password" is shown and they remain on the login page.
expected_result: The system satisfies AC2 exactly, including the stated outcome and message/state.

title: Wrong password stays on login
preconditions: Feature is available with required test data.
steps: Enter correct email and wrong password; click Log In.
expected_result: Exactly 'Invalid email or password' is shown and the user remains on the login page.

title: AC3: verify the required behavior
preconditions: Required feature state and valid test data are available.
steps: Execute the exact condition described in AC3: When an email that is not registered is entered with any password, then the same generic "Invalid email or password" error is shown (no indication of whether the email exists).
expected_result: The system satisfies AC3 exactly, including the stated outcome and message/state.

title: Unknown email cannot be enumerated
preconditions: Feature is available with required test data.
steps: Enter an unregistered email with a password and submit.
expected_result: The exact generic 'Invalid email or password' message is shown; no indication reveals whether the email exists.

title: AC4: verify the required behavior
preconditions: Required feature state and valid test data are available.
steps: Execute the exact condition described in AC4: When either field is left blank and Log In is clicked, then inline validation prompts the user to fill the required field(s); no request is sent.
expected_result: The system satisfies AC4 exactly, including the stated outcome and message/state.

title: Blank required fields are validated inline
preconditions: Feature is available with required test data.
steps: Leave email blank, password blank, then each field blank separately; click Log In.
expected_result: Inline required-field prompts identify the missing field(s), and no authentication request is sent.

title: AC5: verify the required behavior
preconditions: Required feature state and valid test data are available.
steps: Execute the exact condition described in AC5: When the email field contains a value that is not a valid email format, then an inline "Enter a valid email address" message is shown.
expected_result: The system satisfies AC5 exactly, including the stated outcome and message/state.

title: Malformed email formats
preconditions: Feature is available with required test data.
steps: Submit user, user@, @example.com, user@@example.com and user name@example.com.
expected_result: Each malformed email shows inline 'Enter a valid email address'.

title: AC6: verify the required behavior
preconditions: Required feature state and valid test data are available.
steps: Execute the exact condition described in AC6: After 5 consecutive failed attempts within 15 minutes, the account is temporarily locked for 30 minutes and a "Your account is locked. Try again later." message is shown, even if correct credentials are subsequently entered.
expected_result: The system satisfies AC6 exactly, including the stated outcome and message/state.

title: Five failures lock the account
preconditions: Feature is available with required test data.
steps: Submit 5 consecutive wrong-password attempts within 15 minutes, then submit correct credentials.
expected_result: After the fifth failure the account is locked for 30 minutes and correct credentials still show 'Your account is locked. Try again later.'.

title: AC7: verify the required behavior
preconditions: Required feature state and valid test data are available.
steps: Execute the exact condition described in AC7: The email is case-insensitive (User@x.com == user@x.com); the password is case-sensitive.
expected_result: The system satisfies AC7 exactly, including the stated outcome and message/state.

title: Password casing is significant
preconditions: Feature is available with required test data.
steps: Use the correct email but alter password casing.
expected_result: Authentication fails because the password is case-sensitive.

title: AC8: verify the required behavior
preconditions: Required feature state and valid test data are available.
steps: Execute the exact condition described in AC8: On successful login a session is established; on browser refresh the user remains logged in until the session expires (24 hours) or they log out.
expected_result: The system satisfies AC8 exactly, including the stated outcome and message/state.

title: Expired session cannot access dashboard
preconditions: Feature is available with required test data.
steps: Refresh or navigate to the dashboard after expiry.
expected_result: The user is no longer authenticated and must log in again.

title: AC9: verify the required behavior
preconditions: Required feature state and valid test data are available.
steps: Execute the exact condition described in AC9: A user whose account is deactivated sees "This account is inactive. Contact support." and is not logged in.
expected_result: The system satisfies AC9 exactly, including the stated outcome and message/state.

title: Inactive account is not authenticated
preconditions: Feature is available with required test data.
steps: Enter the inactive user's correct email and password.
expected_result: The exact 'This account is inactive. Contact support.' message is shown and no authenticated session is created.

title: Password length rule
preconditions: Feature is available with required test data.
steps: Use a valid account and try password lengths 7, 8, 64, and 65.
expected_result: 8 and 64 character passwords are accepted; 7 and 65 character passwords are rejected according to the password constraint.

title: Session starts after successful login
preconditions: Feature is available with required test data.
steps: Log in successfully and inspect authenticated state/session.
expected_result: A session is established and the user is authenticated on the dashboard.

title: Verify the nearest requirement boundary
preconditions: Boundary values are available.

title: Failed login contributes to lockout
preconditions: Feature is available with required test data.
steps: Submit consecutive wrong passwords and count failures.
expected_result: Each failed authentication is rejected and the failures contribute to the AC6 lockout threshold.

title: Unknown email with password length boundaries
preconditions: Feature is available with required test data.
steps: Submit the unknown email with passwords of 8 and 64 characters.
expected_result: The same generic authentication error is returned without account enumeration.

title: Registered-wrong-password and unknown-email responses match
preconditions: Feature is available with required test data.
steps: Compare registered+wrong-password with unregistered+any-password.
expected_result: Both paths expose the same generic authentication error and do not reveal account existence.

title: One blank field at a time
preconditions: Feature is available with required test data.

expected_result: Only the missing field is prompted and no authentication request is sent in either case.

title: Whitespace-only required fields
preconditions: Feature is available with required test data.
steps: Enter whitespace-only values in email/password and click Log In.

title: Email format near valid boundary
preconditions: Feature is available with required test data.

title: Email normalization does not bypass format validation
preconditions: Feature is available with required test data.

title: Lockout thresholds and time window
preconditions: Feature is available with required test data.
steps: Compare 4 failures vs 5 failures; place failures inside and outside the 15-minute window.
expected_result: Four failures do not lock the account; five qualifying consecutive failures within 15 minutes do; failures outside the window do not incorrectly satisfy the threshold.

title: Lock expires after 30 minutes
preconditions: Feature is available with required test data.
steps: Attempt correct credentials immediately, just before 30 minutes, and at/after 30 minutes.
expected_result: Correct credentials are rejected during the lock period and accepted after the 30-minute lock expires, subject to other account rules.

title: Email casing permutations
preconditions: Feature is available with required test data.
steps: Try User@x.com, user@x.com, USER@X.COM and mixed-case variants with the same password.
expected_result: All email-case variants authenticate as the same account.

title: Password case permutations
preconditions: Feature is available with required test data.
steps: Try Password, password, PASSWORD and mixed-case variants.
expected_result: Only the exact registered password casing succeeds.

title: Session expiry boundary
preconditions: Feature is available with required test data.
steps: Refresh at 23:59:59 and then at 24:00:00 after login.
expected_result: The session remains valid before 24 hours and expires at the defined 24-hour boundary.

title: Refresh, logout and direct navigation session behavior
preconditions: Feature is available with required test data.
steps: Refresh the dashboard, log out, refresh again, then navigate directly to the dashboard URL.

title: Inactive status blocks even correct credentials
preconditions: Feature is available with required test data.

title: Inactive account cannot establish session
preconditions: Feature is available with required test data.
steps: Attempt login and inspect session/dashboard access.
expected_result: No authenticated session exists and protected pages remain inaccessible.
